title: Make agent inbox reads unread-first and expose history/truncation semantics
description: Owner 1d65eac9-45b3-4343-8962-22b38ec6c8aa explicitly requests ONE bounded high-priority proposal following Runtime incident 67926f0f-79db-487e-8066-0b09fbd4ba0e. Runtime read an oldest history page of 20 and locally filtered acknowledgements, falsely reporting no unread messages while 12 unread handoffs remained. Current src/mcp/tools.mjs passes an omitted unacknowledged_only to ControlPlane.readMessages, whose default false selects ASC history before LIMIT. This is selection/pagination semantics, not caching. Provider Runtime owns the identity-bound MCP default; Kernel owns any necessary bound read API/count metadata; QA owns exact behavior specification, additive scenario/path permission and final acceptance. Review precise source/test paths, explicit history selection and pending unread/selection/truncation semantics before behavior changes. No arbitrary state-root access, identity bypass, auto-ack, new manager queue, runtime start, live recovery or authority expansion; keep existing blocked startup reservation work and independent UI/source-qualification items distinct.
acceptanceCriteria: Default identity-bound agent MCP inbox reads select actual unacknowledged addressed/group messages before LIMIT; explicit history remains available with visibly distinct selection semantics.

Given more than 20 acknowledged historical messages and newer pending handoffs, a default read returns pending handoffs and cannot truthfully report unread-zero/no-work merely from a limited history page.

Explicit history and limited/truncated unread results expose sufficient reviewed selection, completeness/truncation and pending-unread metadata to distinguish a page from a complete unread check; metadata is produced through the existing bound read API with a consistent observation contract.
Foreign recipient claims, arbitrary state-root redirection and unauthenticated metadata fail closed; reading never acknowledges, resolves, transfers ownership or changes stored message/ack records.

Named Runtime, Kernel and QA review exact source/API/test contribution paths, strict boundary scenarios including group messages and limits, and deterministic pagination observations before implementation; preserve all existing assertions and add a Test Integrity Note.

Exact clean candidate checks, independent QA acceptance and guarded serialized integration are required; no fixture-only output, omitted unread filter or acknowledgement counts substitute for real current evidence.

Before publishing a final blocked/waiting-on-approval/needs-owner report, refresh authoritative unread inbox, current named permission and task evidence; distinguish a timestamped earlier observation from current state and reconcile already-resolved routine waits without asking the owner again. A mechanical observation-watermark/status protocol, if needed, requires an owned reviewed proposal before schema/API implementation.

Before a failed-check repair/check iteration, refresh the current authoritative brief, actual addressed unread inbox, current task and named consent revisions; apply already-resolved peer direction before further edits or checks. A pending wheel/rAF/scrollend stimulus or an acknowledged historical handoff cannot substitute for current instructions, justify trial timing patches, weakened assertions, duplicate dispatch or a missing-owner-permission claim. Preserve strict behavior, failed receipts and attributable historical evidence; any new mechanical refresh/status protocol needs separately reviewed owned scope.

Before classifying a same-task contribution as duplicate, completed or waiting, refresh the actual addressed unread inbox and compare the exact named current handoff, candidate and requested scope with superseded/completed contributions, even when the task revision is unchanged. Startup/resume UX must distinguish a stale orchestration hint from a pending current contribution and show its provenance; a reused followup flag or terminal old contribution cannot close a new handoff. Any mechanical handoff/version/status schema or activation change remains a separately reviewed owned proposal.

Future reviewed coordination-message reference/pagination UX keeps immutable version-pinned full contracts accessible while returning concise attributable recipient-specific current decision/delta with explicit supersession and exact permission/task revision. Newest actionable decisions are not obscured by repeated long contracts; all recipients, unacknowledged pages, older failed decisions and identity-bound complete/truncated observation remain intact through Kernel565. No summary, repeated-body cohort, read/ack count or historical page can imply resolution, complete unread coverage or transferred approval. Local aggregate traffic is not provider cost/token evidence; this is a requirement only, no new API/schema/code scope.
